D: Two hosers try to get free beer and stumble onto a plot at the Elsinore brewery.
P: Serve the beer when Bob and Doug try to get their free case.
S: Peameal back bacon on a bun
Cornmeal crusted back bacon, fried onions and maple mustard on buns

Thick slices of back bacon rolled in cornmeal, fried crisp and stacked in soft buns with maple mustard and fried onions. Cut 600g piece of back bacon into 8 thick slices and press both sides into 60g fine cornmeal. Fry in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked through. Fry 2 sliced onions in the same pan for 8 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp wholegrain mustard with 2 tbsp maple syrup. Split and toast 8 soft white buns, spread with the maple mustard and fill with bacon and onions.
Fried choux crullers dipped in honey glaze

Light, eggy twisted choux crullers fried golden and dipped in a thin honey glaze that sets crackly on the ridges. Bring 250ml water, 100g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil. Beat in 150g plain flour until it forms a ball, then cool 5 minutes. Beat in 3 eggs one at a time. Pipe 10 rings with a star nozzle onto squares of baking paper. Lower into oil at 180C, paper side up, peel off the paper and fry 3 minutes a side. Drain. Whisk 150g icing sugar, 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp water and dip the warm crullers.
M: Crisp chips with cheese curds and hot beef gravy

Crisp chips topped with squeaky fresh cheese curds or torn mozzarella and smothered in a rich, peppery beef gravy. Bake 1.2kg frozen thick-cut chips at 220C for 30 minutes until crisp. Melt 40g butter, stir in 3 tbsp plain flour and cook 2 minutes until nutty. Whisk in 600ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tsp cracked pepper and simmer 5 minutes until glossy. Tear 300g fresh cheese curds or bocconcini into pieces. Pile the hot chips into 4 bowls, scatter the cheese over and pour the very hot gravy on top.
W: Pastry tarts with a gooey maple butter filling, raisins and pecans

Flaky little pastry tarts filled with a gooey maple, brown sugar and butter filling with raisins and pecans, baked until just set. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust pastry and press into a greased muffin tin. Whisk 100g brown sugar, 80ml maple syrup, 60g melted butter, 1 egg, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt. Put a few raisins and chopped pecans from 40g each into each case. Pour the filling two-thirds of the way up. Bake at 190C for 15 to 18 minutes until the filling bubbles and is just set. Cool in the tin for 15 minutes.
K: Lager and lemonade with maple lemon syrup

Ice-cold lager topped with fresh lemonade and a splash of maple syrup and lemon, served by the stubby glass with a lemon wedge. Stir 3 tbsp maple syrup with the juice of 2 lemons in a jug until combined. Chill 4 beer glasses. Pour 1 tbsp of the maple lemon mix into each glass, then half fill with cold lager, about 180ml. Top with 120ml cold lemonade, pouring slowly down the side to keep the head. Add a lemon wedge. Swap the lager for ginger beer for anyone not drinking.
